name: context-crafter
description: Turn any repository into compact, truthful AI-agent context: overviews, repo maps, dependency graphs, and architecture notes.

interface.shortDescription: Compact, truthful repository context for coding agents.
interface.longDescription: Context Crafter statically analyses a repository and generates a compact context bundle - project overview, repo map, dependency graph, architecture summary, agent brief, and a machine-readable evidence ledger - so a coding agent can orient in an unfamiliar codebase without reading every file.
defaultPrompt: Map this repository so you understand its layout.
Generate an agent context bundle for this repo.
